title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de IA Sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior  para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA  — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação  de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA  Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: • Orquestrador:  Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. • Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert):  cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. • Rules:  Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. • Recovery loops:  quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. • Multi-repo via submodules:  projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. • Stack:  Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer  Manutenção do core (40%)  • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)  • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)  • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você  Stack técnica — obrigatório  • Bash/Shell avançado e Linux  — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((  e porque importa. • Node.js / TypeScript  — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não  usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). • Git e GitHub avançado  — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows. • Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos  — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não  fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou. Experiência  • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs  em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade  • Determinismo > magia.  Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. • Forensics sobre intuição.  Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. • Documentação executável.  Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. • Empatia por agente.  Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais  • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker  em integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules  (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados  (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico  (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios  • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life • Day Off de Aniversário • TotalPass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

Através disso, construímos relações sólidas para sermos o maior ecossistema da construção civil. Contribuir para a gestão e priorização de informações relacionadas ao roadmap e às entregas do time. Apoiar a documentação e comunicação entre stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Dar suporte às rotinas de acompanhamento das iniciativas estratégicas da área.   O que esperamos dessa pessoa  Interesse em tecnologia, produto e engenharia. Boa capacidade de organização e comunicação. Facilidade para atuar em ambientes colaborativos e multidisciplinares. Perfil analítico e atenção aos detalhes. Interesse em aprender sobre gestão de produto técnico, arquitetura e ecossistemas de engenharia. title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.   REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.  Certificações:  Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE  (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Data Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About us:  At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.  Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries. Introduction:  We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this highly autonomous role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation. Responsibilities:  Partner with research, sales, and client stakeholders to translate business objectives into clear analytical approaches, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Lead end-to-end scoping, including framing business questions, defining hypotheses, and recommending appropriate methodologies. Act as the primary analytics interface in Brazil, effectively collaborating with non-technical stakeholders and building strong, trusted relationships. Provide consultative guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from early-stage solutioning through final delivery and interpretation. Serve as a lead analytics practitioner, independently designing and executing advanced quantitative methodologies, including segmentation, brand tracking, pricing and elasticity modeling, conjoint and MaxDiff, ad and concept testing, claims substantiation, driver analysis, media mix modeling, and attribution. Own the end-to-end delivery of analytical projects, ensuring methodological rigor, quality, and business relevance. Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights, with strong storytelling tailored to senior stakeholders by clearly explaining the mechanics behind models and analytical approaches, ensuring transparency and stakeholder confidence in results. Design and develop AI-enabled analytics solutions (e.g., analytical agents, automated insight generation, decision support tools) leveraging LLMs or similar technologies. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance productivity and insight quality across data preparation, modeling, validation, and reporting. Partner with engineering, product, and analytics teams to operationalize solutions at scale, ensuring repeatability and efficiency. Champion automation and standardization, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across engagements. Support the development and adoption of AI governance practices, including responsible use guidelines, bias detection and mitigation, and documentation standards. Ensure all analytical and AI-driven outputs maintain high standards of quality, transparency, and ethical integrity. Balance innovation with rigor, ensuring new approaches are credible, defensible, and client-ready.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles, ideally in a client-facing or consulting environment. Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related quantitative field. Proven ability to lead analytical projects end-to-end, from scoping and problem framing through delivery, including stakeholder management and quality control. Demonstrated ability to work closely with non-technical stakeholders (e.g., research, sales, clients), translating business needs into analytical solutions. Fluency in English is required; additional languages (particularly Portuguese/Spanish) are a strong plus.  **Please submit your CV in English  Our Values:  A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring What we offer:  At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. Other Benefits:  Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal vouchers, transportation vouchers, and language class subsidy. Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Pocket FM  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead  to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market. As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series. The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks. Key Responsibilities  1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction  Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners. Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery. Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals. Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.  2. Promo Creation & Localization  Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series. Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences. Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.  3. Production & Quality Control  Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery. Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output. Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives. Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.  4. Dubbing Agency Management  Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production. Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery. Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit. Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.  5. Performance Reworks & Optimization  Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues. Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance. Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals. Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles. Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.  6. Process, Tracking & Reporting  Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts.   ✅ What You Bring   You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus  5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus. Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar.  English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required).  Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets.  Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours.  Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact.  Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support.     What We Offer (LATAM - Remote)   Fully Remote Setup  Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).   Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals.  Competitive USD compensation  Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration.  Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America.  Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired.  Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere.  Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally.   We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done.  ⏰ Recruitment Process   Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn.  Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience.  Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions.  Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study.  Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit.  Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:

Descrição da vaga  A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização. Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:  ➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio. ➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor. ➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.). ➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um. ➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas. Arquitetura e Design da Solução:  ➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade. ➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência). ➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc). ➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades. ➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc). ➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas. ➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras. ➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.). ➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.  Documentação e Apresentação:  ➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa. ➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados. ➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme). ➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução. ➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo. ➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.  Implementação e Operação:  ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.  Requisitos Diferenciais:  ➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição). ➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração. ➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução. ➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados. ➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas. ➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: ➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos. ➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas. ➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.  Conhecimentos Técnicos:  ➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.). ➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços. ➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.). ➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML). ➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia). ➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas. ➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git). ➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.  Habilidades : ➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. ➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas. ➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas. ➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada. ➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.  Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:  ➢ Proatividade ➢ Pensamento analítico ➢ Orientação a resultados ➢ Colaboração ➢ Adaptabilidade ➢ Aprendizado contínuo

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer  Job Purpose  As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb. The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms. This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function. Role Responsibilities  Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.  Essential Skills & Experience  Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary) 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.  Identity & Authentication Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.  AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence) Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.  Note:  Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow. Service Operations & Remote Working Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.  Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement  This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer: Working hours:  You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office:  Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses:  Discussed at offer stage. On-call:  Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

About Us   Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview   As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards. In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale. Key Responsibilities   Leadership & Workflow Management  Team Leadership & Workflow Management:  Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.  Production Continuity Ownership:  Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.  Cross-Team Asset Coordination:  Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.  Process Standardization:  Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Quality & Content Oversight  Quality Oversight:  Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors. English–Portuguese Alignment:  Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content. Content Integrity Assurance:  Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.  Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management:  Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges. Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards. Risk Prevention & Escalation:  Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.  Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field. Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography. Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role. Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus. Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency. Demonstrated leadership and team management experience. Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills. Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability. Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation. Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams. Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction. Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets. High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes. Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Sobre a posição  Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização. A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor. Principais Responsabilidades  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud. • Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake. • Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes. • Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento. • Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure. • Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados. • Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas. • Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias. Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções. • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis. • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados. • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua. DevOps e Qualidade • Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização. • Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps. • Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas. • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe. Requisitos Obrigatórios  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos). • Experiência prática com Snowflake. • Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures. • Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud. • Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps. • Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados. • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub. • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban). • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global. Diferenciais • Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click. • Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics. • Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas. • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial. • Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira a oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:  MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview:  As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness. Offer Details:   Duration of Contract : 12 months Pay:  $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work:  Fully Remote Number of Positions:  20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)   Key Qualifications:  Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)  with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese  is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.  Education & Experience:  BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.  Additional Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role  Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture  Tech  Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)  What we’re looking for  Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours  What’s in it for you  This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

Formação e Experiência  Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo. Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos. Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow. Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.  Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)  Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js. Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes. DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD). Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).  Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)  Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto. Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio. Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software. Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).  Diferenciais  Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile. Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados. Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados. Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.  Contrato PJ  100% Remoto    E aí, topa o desafio? Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: Head of Liquidity LATAM
description:
Empresa está contratando Head of Liquidity LATAM em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Company  We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview  This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized. Key Responsibilities  Liquidity Management  Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets. Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners. Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance. Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.  FX & Trading Operations  Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows. Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing. Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics. Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.  Counterparty & Vendor Management  Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews. Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.  Risk & Governance  Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight. Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks. Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.  Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement  Lead and develop the liquidity function. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams. Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.  Requirements  Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

description:

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner  with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products. As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule. If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth. Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity. Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model. Responsibilities  End-to-End Delivery:  Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments Cross-Functional Leadership:  Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps Backlog Management:  Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements Quality Assurance:  Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release Process Optimization:  Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments Market Insight:  Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class  Required Experience  Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising Agile Software:  Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning Data Literacy:  Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent  Desired Experience  Marketing Platforms:  Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager  Additional Information  Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP  About Velozient  We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
